Component.name: abstract
Component.Documentation: a summary or formal abstract prefixed to an existing source document by the encoder. (source: TEI P5, 3.4.0)

Element.name: p
Element.Documentation: rough description of the text source and its embeddings

Component.name: textClass
Component.Documentation: (text classification) groups information which describes the nature or topic of a text in terms of a standard classification scheme, thesaurus, etc. (source: TEI P5, 3.4.0)

Element.name: classCode
Element.Documentation: (classification code) contains the classification code used for this text in some standard classification system. (source: TEI P5, 3.4.0)

Attribute.name: scheme
Attribute.Documentation: identifies the classification system in use, as defined by, e.g. a taxonomy element, or some other resource. (source: TEI P5, 3.4.0

Component.name: textDesc
Component.Documentation: (text description) provides a description of a text in terms of its situational parameters. (source: http://www.tei-c.org/release/doc/tei-p5-doc/en/html/ref-textDesc.html)

Element.name: channel
Element.Documentation: (primary channel) describes the medium or channel by which a text is delivered or experienced. For a written text, this might be print, manuscript, e-mail, etc.; for a spoken one, radio, telephone, face-to-face, etc. (source: http://www.tei-c.org/release/doc/tei-p5-doc/en/html/ref-channel.html)
